workflow: The production cad-print package exports the same mixed-size document twice and independent pypdf, pdfplumber and Poppler readers inspect physical sizes, text, exact alpha, transformed paths, border bboxes, colours and raster absence; order, geometry, alpha and a valid referenced image XObject are mutated separately.
result: Direct production bytes exactly matched the Chromium download and remained deterministic. The shared semantic contract accepted the baseline and rejected all four strict-parsing mutants for the expected page-order, line geometry, ExtGState alpha or image-XObject reason.
